nativeValidation.setup: Use a short, disposable checkout of the stated commit and a non-elevated PowerShell session at its repository root. Run commands 1 and 2, copy files.copyFrom to files.copyTo, then run the remaining commands in order. The omission probe uses Go overlays and writes scratch files under .t3-tmp.
commands: if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne 'f116ce6df3bfa5c37aea060b14d96e576a9877cb') { throw 'Unexpected validation revision' }

go test '-v' '-count=1' '-run' '^TestUnattendXML$' './cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/imagebuild' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath '.t3-tmp/answer-file-components-native.log'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native answer-file fixture failed' }
go run $probe 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath '.t3-tmp/answer-file-components-omissions.log'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native answer-file omissions probe failed' }
expectedResults: The native fixture logs a PASS for TestUnattendXML with the current generated answer file.
The first omission reports pass "specialize" is missing required component "Microsoft-Windows-Shell-Setup".
The second omission reports pass "oobeSystem" is missing required component "Microsoft-Windows-Shell-Setup".
The third omission reports pass "oobeSystem" is missing required component "Microsoft-Windows-International-Core".
The probe exits zero after observing one successful fixture run and three expected fixture failures.
outOfScope: Windows Setup, Hyper-V, and native guest acceptance.
